mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (name, emoji, region, start_date, end_date, budget, currency, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{emoji}, #{region}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{budget}, #{currency}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT trip_id, name, emoji, region, start_date, end_date, budget, currency, status, created_at FROM trip WHERE trip_id = #{trip_id}
SELECT trip_id, name, emoji, region, start_date, end_date, budget, currency, status, created_at FROM trip ORDER BY created_at DESC
